explanation.min_unit_price: Company policy: never buy below this, it signals a fake or dumped price.
explanation.max_unit_price: Company policy: never pay above this, it blows the procurement budget.
explanation.min_delivery_days: Legal minimum lead time for customs and quality checks.
explanation.max_delivery_days: Business requirement: can't wait longer than this.
explanation.min_sla_penalty_pct: Every contract must have at least this much penalty protection if supplier is late.
explanation.max_sla_penalty_pct: Penalty can't be so high it's unenforceable/unfair.
